note: Tables for 'firn.py scenario'. Edit freely: every list is rolled with equal weight. Keep entries short and concrete. No weapons are fitted by default (the maker's ruling), so opposition is written as pressure to avoid, not targets to hit.

missions.name: Delivery
missions.objective: carry one armour core from the lab to a handover point
missions.win: core handed over intact, inside the window
missions.loss: core lost or damaged, or anyone hurt

missions.name: Extraction
missions.objective: collect two passengers from a marked point and bring them home
missions.loss: a passenger left behind or hurt
missions.limit: the pick-up point is safe for 10 minutes only

missions.name: Escort
missions.objective: shepherd a slower vehicle along the route and keep it out of trouble
missions.loss: the escorted vehicle is stopped or damaged
missions.limit: the convoy moves at the slow vehicle's pace

missions.name: Recon
missions.objective: scout the route end to end and report surface, sight lines, choke points and places to hide
missions.win: a full report and nobody knows you were there
missions.loss: seen and identified, or the report is incomplete

missions.name: Evasion
missions.objective: you are being followed: lose the tail without leading it home
missions.win: tail lost for 15 clear minutes, then home by another road
missions.loss: followed home, or forced to stop

missions.name: Recovery
missions.objective: reach a stranded vehicle, shelter its crew in the cell and get everyone out
missions.win: crew safe in the cell and clear of the area
missions.loss: the crew cannot be reached in time
missions.limit: the crew can hold for 25 minutes

missions.name: Cradle run
missions.objective: meet the armour at a rendezvous, dock it under the Veil and leave before anyone notices
missions.win: armour docked and the rendezvous left quiet
missions.loss: the dock is seen, or the armour stays behind
missions.limit: the Veil budget decides how long the dock can take

missions.name: Timetable
missions.objective: three stops, three windows, one charge
missions.win: all three windows met with range to spare for the way home
missions.loss: a window missed, or not enough range to get home

missions.name: Blackout
missions.objective: cross a jammed zone on silent running with no link and no outside data
missions.win: through and out with the clock and the map alone
missions.limit: silent running holds only while you stay under 60 km/h

missions.name: Storm front
missions.objective: get the passengers through before the weather closes the road
missions.win: through before the road shuts, everyone comfortable

terrain: mountain pass, hairpins and a 12 percent grade
flooded underpass on a city ring road
ring road in January, black ice wherever the shade falls
forest track, single lane, no turning for 4 km
industrial estate, blind corners and loading bays
coastal road, cliff on one side and crosswind on the other
empty motorway, long sight lines, nowhere to hide
old town, narrow streets, tram lines and pedestrians
long bridge, one way on and one way off
road tunnel, 3 km of radio shadow
open farmland, straight roads, mud at every junction
multi-storey car park and the streets around it
quarry road, loose gravel and drop-offs
weather: dry, +28 C, heat haze on the tarmac
a thaw: wet roads, ice returning after dark
light snow, good grip for now
light: low sun, glare on the glass
opposition: a pursuit car that is faster on the straights
two pursuit vehicles working as a pair
a roadblock somewhere ahead, position unknown
a drone keeping watch from above
an ambush at one of the choke points
a rival team after the same objective
civil traffic only, heavy and unpredictable
an unknown vehicle that mirrors every turn
arms: hand weapons only: clubs, blades and a spear or two, and numbers to make up for it
bows and crossbows from cover, and blades for anyone who comes close
pistols and one rifle, short of ammunition
a blast charge laid somewhere on the route, and one person watching it
grenades and flashbangs: they mean to stop the car, not to wreck it
a mine at a choke point, and nothing else
laser pistols: no travel time and no noise, and they overheat
one heavy laser on a mount, slow to turn, with a clear line of sight to the road
stun weapons only: batons and stunners, because they want everyone alive
a mixed lot: a longbow on the roof, hammers at the gate and one laser rifle
snags: one armour core docked at 20 percent charge
a passenger who gets car-sick: smooth inputs only
the planned route is closed 9 km in
range capped at 400 km for this run
Veil emitters still warm from a test: start with 90 s of heat
a wheel sensor warning that may be a fault
the link to base drops in the valleys
two extra passengers, and the cradle holds one core only
no stopping: the cargo must stay moving
road salt has not reached the side roads
the map is six months out of date
twists: the opposition was never after you
the weather turns for the worse at the halfway point
the destination is not safe when you arrive
a second objective appears on the way
the fastest route is also the most exposed
someone at the rendezvous is early
the link comes back with new orders
you are asked to wait, with the clock running
